title: Sharp Bounds on Continuous Treatment Effects under Unobserved Confounding
abstract: arXiv:2610.33278v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study partial identification of conditional treatment effects with a continuous treatment under unobserved confounding. We target the conditional average potential outcome (CAPO) E[Y_x|z] and the conditional average treatment effect (CATE) between two treatment levels. We assume a bounded outcome and Lipschitz continuity of the response functions and of the propensity scores given the latent confounder, and show that these conditions imply the smooth treatment response and smooth treatment selection conditions of Kim et al. (2018). The combined bound of Kim et al. uses only two reference points on the identified diagonal and is generally loose. Bounding through every diagonal reference point instead gives explicit bounds whose average is the sharp identified set of the CAPO at every treatment, inside or outside the observational support. Capping the difference between the upper and lower bounds gives sharp causal bounds on the CATE.

translated_title: 未知混杂因素下连续处理效应的精确界
translated_abstract: 在存在未知混杂因素的情况下，我们研究了连续处理条件下条件处理效应的部分识别问题。我们的目标是条件平均潜在结果以及两个处理水平之间的条件平均处理效应（CATE）。我们假设结果变量有界，且响应函数以及给定潜在混杂因素下的倾向得分满足Lipschitz连续性，并证明这些条件蕴含了Kim等人（2018）提出的平滑处理响应与平滑处理选择条件。Kim等人的组合界仅使用了已识别对角线上的两个参考点，因而通常较为宽松。相反，通过对每一个对角线参考点分别求界，可以得到显式的界，其平均值即为CAPO在每个处理水平上的精确识别集，无论该处理水平是否位于观测支持范围之内。通过限制上界与下界之间的差异，可以得到CATE的精确因果界。
tldr: 本文在未知混杂因素下，利用Lipschitz连续性假设，通过对所有对角线参考点求界的平均值得到连续处理下CAPO的精确识别集，并通过限制上下界之差得到CATE的精确因果界。
en_tdlr: This paper derives sharp identified sets for the CAPO under continuous treatment with unobserved confounding by averaging explicit bounds over all diagonal reference points, and obtains sharp causal bounds on the CATE by capping the width between the upper and lower bounds.
